name: ftksaas
description: FtkSaaS backend contracts and isolated development baseline

scripts.generate: python3 scripts/generate-runtime.py && node scripts/generate-validators.mjs && node scripts/build-edge.mjs && node scripts/generate.mjs && python3 scripts/render_catalogs.py
scripts.verify: python3 scripts/check-migrations.py && python3 scripts/generate-runtime.py --check && node scripts/generate-validators.mjs --check && node scripts/build-edge.mjs --check && node scripts/generate.mjs --check && python3 scripts/render_catalogs.py --check && node scripts/audit.mjs && node scripts/governance.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node --test tests/contract.test.mjs tests/governance.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run test:db && npm run test:api
scripts.db:advisors: supabase db advisors --local --type all --level warn --fail-on error
scripts.test:api: node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/api-acceptance.test.mjs tests/event-payment.test.mjs tests/event-cancellation.test.mjs tests/registry.test.mjs tests/person-registry.test.mjs tests/room-role-registry.test.mjs tests/availability-policies.test.mjs tests/schedule-reads.test.mjs tests/program-session-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/starter-attendance-protection.test.mjs
